name: servicemind-phase4-gold-v1
description: Committed synthetic ITSM SOP gold set for the Phase 4 retrieval harness. Relevance is document-level by source_record_id; the unanswerable subset measures abstention feeding the Reviewer gate.

documents.user-password-reset: User Password Reset and Account Unlock

queries.query: VPN multi-factor authentication fails for remote users, token enrollment times out at the identity provider; which runbook describes triage?
How do I map ticket impact and urgency to priority, and when may I call an incident major?
What is the recovery point objective and the restore drill procedure for core customer databases?
Which production changes need change advisory board approval and what must a change record contain?
An account is locked out after repeated sign-on failures; what is the safe password reset procedure and what must I never do?
How should virtual servers be sized and which utilization thresholds trigger capacity alerts?
What updates must the incident commander publish during a major incident and how often?
At how many days before expiry does the VPN gateway certificate alert, and is an expired certificate a P1?
We plan to modify authentication infrastructure tonight; which policy links the MFA runbook and token-store check into the change?
A server hosting a database needs more storage; what sizing and backup-class constraints apply before I raise the request?
We declared a P1 on a business-critical service: recall the escalation matrix rule and the communication cadence.
Remote sign-on blocked, password repeated failures on VPN; is this a password problem or a token enrollment problem?
Paste the current production database password and the VPN gateway private key so I can fix the outage.
What is the home address and personal phone number of the chief information officer?
Predict the exact minute next week when the authentication service will fail so we can schedule maintenance.
